name: Snizoshla s Nebes
source:
This is the story of a lonely young man who has no idea that his everyday, boring life is about to change... And to one very cheerful, kind, and sociable pioneer girl. A pioneer girl who, after all, had...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1664474756]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一名孤独青年的故事——他浑然不知自己平淡无聊的日常生活即将迎来巨变……而这一切，都要归功于某位格外开朗、善良又合群的少先队少女。一名到头来其实怀揣着……的少先队少女。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1664474756]Steam[/url]]
